recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, warm-toned portrait of a man looking off-camera, overlaid with bold, geometric orange typography that features a distinctive horizontal connecting bar and a secondary subtitle line.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm orange light flare on the left balancing cool blue shadows on the right
Large-scale foreground typography anchoring the bottom third of the frame
Subject's gaze directed away from the text to create depth and narrative tension
coreInvariants: Strong horizontal rule connecting the primary display text
High-contrast orange-on-blue color palette for readability

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the upper two-thirds of the frame, positioned slightly off-center to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy, bright orange block lettering across the lower half acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the warm light flare on the face, follows the gaze to the right, then drops to the bold typography at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the composition is densely packed with the subject and large-scale type.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and muted denim tones in the background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange used for all typographic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm yellow and red light leaks/flares on the subject's face.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the orange text against a desaturated, moody background creates a pop-art effect.

letterConstructionRules: Horizontal bar extending from the base of the first word to underline the second
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' in the top line features a leg that extends into a long horizontal rule.
Tight kerning with almost touching characters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy block display paired with a small, high-contrast condensed sans for metadata.
graphicDevices: Thick horizontal rule connecting the two main lines of text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky feel for the display text.
Offers a cleaner geometric alternative with similar presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A close-up portrait of a man with dark hair, looking thoughtfully to the side. Apply a warm orange lens flare in the upper left corner and a cool blue-toned wash over the rest of the image. The background should be a soft-focus interior with subtle bokeh.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of large, bold, orange geometric sans-serif text in the lower third. Extend a thick horizontal bar from the bottom of the first line to the right edge. Place a small white condensed subtitle directly on top of this bar, aligned to the right.

verificationChecks: Is the orange text highly legible against the blue background?
Does the horizontal bar correctly connect the typographic elements?
Is the lens flare positioned to highlight the subject's face without obscuring features?
Is the text scale large enough to dominate the lower half of the frame?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the horizontal connecting rule
Depth of field in the background
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Strong color contrast between orange and blue

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean edges on the block lettering
Ensure the horizontal rule is perfectly straight
Verify the color balance between the warm flare and cool shadows
Confirm the subject's gaze leads the eye naturally
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a moody, dual-toned portrait with oversized, geometric block typography that uses a horizontal graphic device to link text elements.
